thread:
maya: Quick sync — need signoff on rollout plan for tenant-routing-v3 (staged experiments + automated fallback checks). Outline below, please ack/comment.

kevin: Ack. High-level?

maya: Plan:
- phase 1: shadow (24h), sample 1% tenants
- phase 2: micro-canary 0.5% traffic -> 5 tenants, 4h hold
- phase 3: progressive ramp doubling every 2h to 50% or until gate
- shutters: auto-evict based on SLOs + anomaly detector
- safety nets: synthetic probes, circuit breaker, per-tenant fallback to legacy model

lucas: Suggest synthetic probe run every 1m; pass criteria p95 < 250ms and error rate < 0.5% for 10m window.

sara: Also require quality guard: generate 50 golden prompts, compare embedding similarity > 0.88 avg to baseline; fail -> rollback.

maya: Good — add to runbook. Add canary config:

```
feature_flag: tenant-routing-v3
cohorts:
  - name: shadow-1pct
    type: shadow
    targets: sample(1%)
  - name: micro-canary
    type: progressive
    initial: 5 tenants
    step: x2 every 2h
fallbacks:
  - name: per-tenant-fallback
    trigger:
      latency_multiplier: 2.0
      sustained_secs: 120
      error_rate_spike: 2x
  - name: global-degrade
    trigger:
      outage_score: >0.7
      action: route-to-model-legacy
```

kevin: Minor: change p95 to 200ms for EU region, because lower latency baseline.

anna: Ops notes: we need deploy-bot check to run smoke tests + synthetic probes pre-cutover. Also add probe command:

```
/run-synthetic-probe --cohort=shadow-1pct --prompts=50 --interval=60s
```

deploy-bot: Preflight hooks queued: unit tests ok, infra-check ok, synthetic-probe scheduled.

sara: Telemetry: add these dashboards/alerts
- p95 latency by cohort
- error rate by tenant (5m)
- golden-prompt-similarity trending
- anomaly-detection score (auto-evict recommended)

lucas: Rollback policy: auto-evict cohort if any trigger fires; manual rollback if >3 cohorts evicted within 24h.

maya: Decision needed: enable auto-evict during business hours only? ops prefers 24/7 auto-evict.

kevin: Vote: 24/7 auto-evict + paging alerts for SRE on any auto-evict.

sara: Agree. Add opt-out for top-tier enterprise customers to require manual confirmation.

maya: Final asks before I ship the flag tomorrow:
- kevin confirm EU latency threshold change
- lucas confirm probe cadence
- anna add deploy-bot preflight hook to run probes
- sara add dashboards + pager thresholds

kevin: Confirmed (EU p95 200ms).

lucas: Probe cadence OK (60s; 10m aggregation windows).

anna: Deploy-bot updated — will run preflight probes and fail on golden similarity < 0.88.

sara: Dashboards + pager created, thresholds set.

maya: Thanks — I'll schedule the rollout and post the canary slice list here. :thumbsup:
